summary: This note is a short biographical entry on American actress and model Samira Wiley, born April 15, 1987. It says she is best known for playing Poussey Washington in the Netflix series Orange Is the New Black and Moira in the Hulu series The Handmaid's Tale. She was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Drama Series for the Handmaid's Tale role. The two paragraphs repeat the same content.
